author: Inside Edition
description: The lone juror who held his ground in the Lindsay Clancy murder trial is finding himself under fire. According to the other jury members in the recent trial, the juror, who has not been named publicly, was the only one that wanted to find Clancy guilty of criminally murdering her three children. He reportedly has a history of domestic violence allegations. Since the jury was unable to reach a unanimous decision, a mistrial was declared. As Inside Edition's Ann Mercogliano reports, the governor of Florida is now offering him asylum.
title: Holdout Jury In Lindsay Clancy Trial Gets Florida Asylum Offer

author: Inside Edition
description: Jeff Arnett was on a mission to fulfill his father's dying wish. His father, John, knew he was in his final days when he told his son that he had lost his wedding ring decades ago while washing his car in the front yard of his Toledo, Ohio, home. John passed away in 2013 at age 78. That's when Jeff started searching for the ring. He finally found it and told Inside Edition's Emma Keady about that moment.
title: Man Finds His Late Father's Wedding Ring Decades After It Went Missing

author: Inside Edition
description: School is back in session and authorities want students to have a safe year. But already there have been some close calls for kids exiting school buses. The Washington County Sheriff's Office in Kentucky has released video of a driver ignoring a stopped school bus and passing the vehicle as students were about to cross the street. There were no reported injuries. Inside Edition Digital's Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Cops Warn Drivers to Stop For School Buses After Kids Nearly Hit By Cars

author: Inside Edition
description: The Town of Ramapo Police Department was tasked with recapturing an emu that escaped from a local petting zoo. It's probably not something these officers trained for. They used a drone to track down the runaway bird, but then they had to wrangle it, which was easier said than done. The drone kept watch over the scene as an officer finally got a leash on the animal and then it appears they took a long walk back to where it escaped from. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Cops Catch Runaway Emu And Return It To Petting Zoo

author: Inside Edition
description: Reeva Gupta shares the story of a 2023 plane crash she survived that killed her mother, Roma Gupta.
title: Woman Survives Plane Crash That Killed Her Mother #shorts
